summary: Oculis Holding AG filed a Form 6-K announcing topline results from its Phase 3 DIAMOND trials of OCS-01 for diabetic macular edema. The primary endpoint (BCVA at week 52) was not met; secondary retinal thickness reduction was observed. The company will not pursue an FDA filing for this indication. The filing discloses no corporate event such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring — only routine drug-development results. As a foreign-issuer report of clinical data, it maps to a U.S. earnings/update release. There are no deal terms, no special-situation mechanics, and no actionable risk-arb angle; the sole takeaway is pipeline reallocation.
